title: InspectionRequestV1
description: Public page-inspection contract, version runner.inspection.v1. Submits a URL and receives the page's input fields and submit control, each with a ranked selector. Unlike an execution it carries no Test IR: nothing is clicked, filled or asserted.

contractVersion.description: Rejected with CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED if the Runner does not support it.

requestId.description: Caller-side correlation id, echoed in the result.

tenantRef.description: Opaque tenant identifier owned by the calling service. The Runner never interprets it.

workspaceRef.description: Opaque workspace identifier. Scopes the Registry and all authorization checks.

url.description: The page to inspect. Only http and https are accepted, so a request can never reach a local file or an internal scheme.

authProfileRef.description: Runner-owned execution profile used to reach an authenticated page. Credentials are referenced, never inlined.

waitUntil.description: Use networkidle for a page that renders its form client-side.

waitForMs.description: Settle time after navigation, for late-rendering widgets.

includeNonInputControls.description: Also report links, tabs and menu items, not only fields to fill in.

rootSelector.description: Inspect only inside this container, as a CSS selector. For an application that renders everything into one panel, so the result excludes the surrounding shell. It names where to look and never becomes a target, so Test IR still carries no selectors. The element cap applies inside the container, so a panel on a long page keeps its elements. A selector matching nothing fails with ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND naming it, rather than silently inspecting the whole page.
